title: Koala eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='14' fill='#c9a6e8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='14' fill='#c9a6e8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='26' r='9' fill='#e7d4f5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='26' r='9' fill='#e7d4f5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#a9b8d4'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#d4e0f0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='36' r='4' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='4' fill='#5b4b8a'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#7c6ca8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#9a8cc4'/>
  <!-- mouth chewing -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#7c6ca8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#ff9eb5'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='47' r='4' fill='#f0a6c0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='47' r='4' fill='#f0a6c0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#a9b8d4'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='14' ry='14' fill='#d4e0f0'/>
  <!-- arm holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='72' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#a9b8d4' transform='rotate(-20 36 72)'/>
  <!-- snack: leaf/eucalyptus cookie -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='66' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#7ed957' transform='rotate(-15 34 66)'/>
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='65' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#a8f07a' transform='rotate(-15 34 65)'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='63' r='1.2' fill='#4ea832'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='68' r='1.2' fill='#4ea832'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='72' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#a9b8d4' transform='rotate(20 64 72)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='95' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8fa3c4'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='95' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#8fa3c4'/>
</svg>
